title: Serve the European startup callback table from extracted data
changes: Authenticate and extract the complete 12-slot startup callback table and both boot literals into engine.thumb-pc-literals. Select the new layout in e324-d323 and preserve e323-d322 attachment.
validation: Windows build b_vm92ph and the single Wine installer case qhrwrz0g pass. The server drains. All 14 original 32-bit loads are typed with altered ROM backing, all 12 IWRAM slots agree, and guest clock, audio and full state match. The previous lookup and e323-d322 attachment pass. A current manifest and packet with the new group removed are rejected without replacing the active owner.
limitations: Subsequent callback dispatch, translated execution, original BIOS, native Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements. Primary Terra/xhigh settings unconfirmed.
